label: D2 after a2 rare-transitioned to S1, late episode, when a2 was the bad choice
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S1 by a rare transition. Every activation in dev meets this condition (recall 1.0), but only about 4% of such steps fire (F1 0.08). It never fires at D1 or GO, on a1 choices, on common transitions, or on S2 arrivals. Within a2->S1 rare, firing is strongly enriched late in the episode (trial >= 60; almost none before trial 30), when a2 was not the good choice (good = S1, chose_good = 0), on switch trials (stay = 0), and when the value is low and the D2 policy logit is not strongly committed to a2. Adding chose_good == 0 and ep_trial >= 60 gives dev P 0.31 / R 0.68 / F1 0.43 / mass 0.72. Using choice > -4.44 instead of chose_good gives F1 0.47. Neither a reward nor a stay condition separates firing from non-firing much further. Top activations are mostly on rel 0/+1 switches to a2 that land rare in S1. Only observed or inferable variables are used: action, state and transition are known at D2, and good is hidden but inferable.
